title: AIHandoffPacket
description: Transfer packet used when a Claude Code or Codex session approaches context limits and must hand off to the next agent

currentTask.description: Name or short description of the package/task in progress

lastCommit.description: Hash and message of last commit

filesModified.description: List of files modified or created since last commit

whatWasDone.description: Summary of what has been completed in this session

whatRemains.description: Summary of what still needs to be done

knownIssues.description: Any issues, blockers, or uncertainties the next agent should know about

testDetails.description: Details of test run if tests were run

nextWork.description: Exactly what the next agent should do first

contextNeeded.description: Critical context the next agent needs that isn't in the code or docs

scopeGuardReminder.description: Specific scope-guarded areas the next agent must not touch

doNotCommit.description: Reminder: do not commit without explicit user instruction
